title: Objective reality emerges as an asymptotic statistical phenomenon

statements.text: When one observer, Bob, is old and complex enough and keeps his memory, the chances that govern him as he appears in another observer's world converge to his own first-person chances. Observers then come to share one world: objective reality is derived, not assumed.
statements.conditions: Bob's observer state is long, and the locator that reads him out of Alice's world keeps yielding a growing state (Assumption 5.1).

sources.quote: objective reality is not assumed on this approach but rather provably emerges as an asymptotic statistical phenomenon
